去茶城？

去是肯定得去的。

不过在去之前，自己得先做好准备。

略微思索片刻，林舒开口对秦朗说道：

“我们得拖到明天再出发。”

“明天？”

秦朗愣了一愣。

“为什么？”

“我得等。”

林舒回答道：

“我这里有一套仪轨，可以看到我的死亡。”

“这套仪轨的冷却时间是3天----我得等到今天晚上8点钟，进行下一次占卜，确定死亡风险之后，再决定要不要去、去的话应该做哪些准备。”

话音落下，房间里再一次安静下来。

包括陆染、靳越、秦朗在内，没有任何人开口。

寂静的空间里只剩下了机器散热风扇的嗡嗡声，以及所有人的呼吸声。

良久之后，秦朗才用难以置信的眼神看向林舒，开口问道：

“你是说，你手里掌握着一套......可以预测未来的仪轨？？”

“啊？”

林舒愣了。

不是，你到底是在惊讶什么？！

理论上来说，在历史上流传下来的各种仪轨里，除了“趋吉避凶”、“斩妖除魔”的那些仪轨，流传最广的不就是预测、占卜类的吗？

你到大街上看看，你到网上看看，只要是打着玄学旗号的，哪个不是说自己能“见未来”？

这甚至都不仅限于玄学了。

它已经泛化到成为一种“文化”了好吗？

流传那么广、基数那么大，有真东西掺杂在里面也不奇怪吧？？

“这......很少见吗？”

林舒试探着询问，而秦朗则是苦笑着摇头。

本来以为这小子只是不小心被卷入了事件中，成为了连接各个案件的“关键节点”。

没想到越跟他接触，越发现他不简单。

先是在一夜之间复原、甚至是改进了平安符。

紧接着又发现，他居然才是敌方猎杀的核心目标。

本来自己还在怀疑，就算他有点天赋，也不应该那么招人惦记吧。

结果现在你告诉我，你还能“预测未来”。

难怪人家要杀你呢......你这不该的吗！？

匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。

设身处地的想，如果自己站在对立面，在使用某种手段提前获知了对手的“预测能力”之后，要做的第一件事情，也就是把他干掉吧......

略微沉默片刻，秦朗解释道：

“占卜、预测的仪轨实际上并不罕见，但有效果的极少极少。”

Going to tea town?

You must go.

But before you go, you have to prepare yourself.

After thinking for a moment, Lin Shu said to Qin Lang:

"We'll have to wait until tomorrow."

"Tomorrow?"

Qin Lang was stunned for a moment.

"Why?"

"I have to wait."

Lin Shu replied:

"I have a ritual here to see my death."

"The cooling time of this ritual is 3 days - I have to wait until 8 o'clock tonight for the next divination. After determining the risk of death, I can then decide whether to go and what preparations should be made if I go."

After the words fell, the room became quiet again.

No one spoke, including Lu Ran, Jin Yue, and Qin Lang.

The only sounds left in the silent space were the hum of the machine's cooling fan and everyone's breathing.

After a long time, Qin Lang looked at Lin Shu with disbelief and asked:

"You mean, you hold in your hands a set of... rituals that can predict the future??"

"Huh?"

Lin Shu was stunned.

No, what are you surprised about?!

Theoretically speaking, among the various rituals handed down in history, apart from those of "seeking good luck and avoiding evil" and "slaying demons and eliminating demons", aren't the most widely spread ones those related to prediction and divination?

You can look on the street or online. As long as it’s under the banner of metaphysics, which one doesn’t claim to be able to “see the future”?

This isn't even limited to metaphysics anymore.

It has become so generalized that it has become a kind of "culture", okay?

It is so widely circulated and has such a large base, it is not surprising that there are real things mixed in it, right??

"Is this...rare?"

Lin Shu asked tentatively, while Qin Lang smiled bitterly and shook his head.

I originally thought that this kid was just accidentally involved in the incident and became a "key node" connecting various cases.

Unexpectedly, the more I got in touch with him, the more I discovered that he was not simple.

First, the peace charm was restored and even improved overnight.

Then it was discovered that he was actually the core target of the enemy's hunt.

Originally, I was still doubting that even if he had some talent, he shouldn't be so remembered.

As a result, now you tell me that you can also "predict the future."

No wonder they want to kill you... shouldn't you??

The common man is not guilty, but he is guilty of carrying the jade.

Put yourself in their shoes, if you were on the opposite side, and after using some means to learn about your opponent's "prediction ability" in advance, the first thing you would do is to kill him...

After a moment of silence, Qin Lang explained:

"The rituals of divination and prediction are actually not uncommon, but they are very, very few that are effective."
